notes.title: UPDATE: Version: 0.2.3.35
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843532/c47960b869964e01e23e3b47accf5f7671e9075d.png[/img]

[h1]Version: 0.2.3.35[/h1]

[h2]New DEADLINE game mode![/h2]
You have 10 seconds to answer each question. Contains stars for all question sets, all sets included and 3 difficulty modes to choose from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843532/ea73e2991a385bc131ccb943174a7ed7cba1cf9e.png[/img]
 
[h3]Other Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]More 'Movies' questions added.
[*]Casual star requirements rebalanced.
[*]Detonation correct is now +3 sec.
[*]Detonation wrong answers -2 sec.
[*]Detonation stars added.
[*]Detonation mode achievements added.
[*]XP bar is gold on max level.
[*]Bonus Levels 55+56 added (no associated achievement).
[*]Rebalanced XP to each rank again.
[*]New 'Goals box' refresh button.
[*]Fixed some none displaying characters.
[*]Fixed more typos and question errors.
[/list]
ːUltimatePieceː

tags.feature: XP bar is gold on max level.

tags.balance_change: Rebalanced XP to each rank again.

tags.bug: Fixed more typos and question errors.

notes.title: UPDATE: Version: 0.2.2.30
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843532/c47960b869964e01e23e3b47accf5f7671e9075d.png[/img]

[h1]Version: 0.2.2.30[/h1]

[h2]New DETONATION game mode![/h2]
Start with 25 seconds and gain +5 seconds per question answered, Once the time runs out... BOOM!. Contains leaderboards for all question sets, answer as many correct questions as you can, all sets included and 3 difficulty modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44843532/a8fd1a2d34e53910f412ec171430912e556a7332.png[/img]
 
[h2]NEW QUESTIONS SET: Video Games[/h2]
Currently containing 75 questions, with more to be added ːgoldenbitː

[h3]Other Patch Notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]'Movies' question set increased from 101 to 148.
[*]XP to first rank lowered to 200.
[*]Rebalanced XP to each rank.
[*]Total stars raised to 660.
[*]Fixed typos and question errors.
[/list]
ːUltimatePieceː
